method: Every digest is SHA-256 (WebCrypto) over the file's exact bytes, or over its exact text where the asset is in-document. Hosted assets were fetched and hashed separately from their local counterparts, then compared — so 'the hosted copy is the original' is a measurement here, not an assumption. Nothing is hand-typed: re-run the register pass (execute_js: hash the tree, then write this file) — or read it back with /relay, which rebuilds this same census in the browser, file by file, and names anything that has moved — or read it back with /relay, which rebuilds this same census in the browser, file by file, and names anything that has moved — or read it back with /relay, which rebuilds this same census in the browser, file by file, and names anything that has moved and it states the tree as it is.
